scientific.claim: For three independent uses of the pentagon confusability channel, equivalently the strong graph power \(C_5^{\boxtimes 3}\), the maximum zero-error code size is \(10\). Exactly \(391{,}600\) maximum codes of size \(10\) exist on the labeled alphabet \((\mathbb Z/5\mathbb Z)^3\), and exactly \(31{,}328\) contain any prescribed word. Under the natural channel-isometry group \(G=(D_{10})^3\rtimes S_3\) of order \(6000\), the maxima form exactly \(85\) orbits. Their stabilizer-order distribution is \(1^{53},2^{19},3^2,4^7,8^1,10^2,40^1\). The unique orbit with stabilizer order \(40\) has representative \(\{(0,0,0),(0,0,2),(1,2,0),(1,2,2),(2,4,0),(2,4,2),(3,1,0),(3,1,2),(4,3,0),(4,3,2)\}\).
